## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Two important issues need fixing: `slugify` drops accented and non-Latin letters, so some titles produce wrong or empty slugs, and the PR description has no `## Testing` section, which AGENTS.md requires.

## Changes
This pull request adds `app/slug.py` with a `slugify(title)` helper that lowercases a title, collapses runs of characters outside `[a-z0-9]` into a hyphen, and trims hyphens from both ends. It also adds `tests/test_slug.py`, which tests four inputs.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/slug.py:7 — correctness — Keep non-ASCII letters in slugs or say they are dropped — The title "Café Menu" becomes "caf-menu" and "日本語" becomes "", because `[^a-z0-9]+` treats letters such as "é" as separators even though the PR body promises to replace only non-alphanumeric characters. — Pages with non-English titles get wrong URLs, or an empty slug that can collide with other pages. — Fix: Either transliterate first (`unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", ...)` plus an ASCII encode) or match with `[\W_]+`, then add these titles to the cases in `test_slugify`.
- PR body — correctness — Add a `## Testing` section to the PR description — The PR description has no `## Testing` section, which breaks the rule at AGENTS.md:4: "Every pull-request description has a `## Testing` section that says how the change was verified." — Reviewers cannot see how you verified this change, and the project's contributor rule is not met.
